item.tib: lha mo srid rgyal dpon g.yog gi las gzhung bsam don kun 'grub
item.coloph: sangs rgyas sems dpa' rig 'dzin gyi/ 'phrin las sgrub mdzad ma mo yi/ las rim yid bzhin mdzod kyi gter/ bsam don kun 'grub thabs chen 'di/ nges nges sems la lhug par 'char ba rnams/ yang yang sems dpa' rgya mtshos bskul ba'i skabs/ dung dung la mos lag bskul sdod ma ster/ gsal gsal yi ge bkod pa shin tu rmad/ thog mar lha mos lung bstan chags btab nas/ bar du lha mos srung zhing skyong ba'i gnas/ ma 'ongs lha mos yun du dar rgyas su/ mdzad gyur lha mos 'khor ba'i dgon gling du/ lha rgyal sgo rigs rnal 'byor che/ khro rgyal 'grub pa'i dbal gshen gyis/ rtse rgyal dgongs pa'i gter chen gyis/ srid rgyal sgrab pa'i thun skabs bris/ sog dgon nor bu gling chen du/ du kha spangs pa'i tshul ldan rnams/ rnam dag blo yis nyams su longs/ longs spyod tshe nor bstan pa dar/ 'di sbyar dpal yon dpyid char rab bzang gis/ lnga bod bstan pa'i ljon tshal rab rgyas shing / khrims ldan ud 'bar gling chen rab bzhad nas/ 'gro kun dad mos rgyu ru rab gyur cig bkra shis dpal 'bar 'dzam gling rgyan gyur shog/
